description: This file contains JavaScript code for geolocation functionalities, including obtaining user location via IP, browser geolocation, Google Maps integration, and Google Places autocomplete, with functions for geocoding, map setup, and event handling.

methods.name: getUserLocation
methods.description: Obtains user location, either from cache or via IP geolocation API, and executes callback with data.

methods.name: saveGeolocationData
methods.description: Sends geolocation data to server API endpoint for storage.

methods.name: setLocationFromGeoip
methods.description: Fetches geolocation data based on IP address via API and executes callback.

methods.name: getLocationFromBrowser
methods.description: Uses browser's geolocation API and Google Maps Geocoder to get user's location and address details.

methods.name: setLocationFromBrowser
methods.description: Wrapper to get location from browser and save it.

methods.name: geoCode
methods.description: Performs geocoding on a given object (coordinates or address) and executes callback.

methods.name: setGoogleMapPoint
methods.description: Initializes Google Map with markers, geocoding, and event handling on a DOM element.

methods.name: getGoogleAddressFromAutocomplete
methods.description: Extracts structured address data from Google Places autocomplete result.

methods.name: changePlace
methods.description: Populates form fields and updates map based on selected Google Place.

methods.name: setGoogleAutocomplete
methods.description: Sets up Google Places autocomplete on input fields.
